meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去查你在 cmem.ai 上的 Claude-Mem 记忆,里面是历史会话留下的带时间戳观察记录。它先用宽泛关键词搜,再用更精确的词收窄,最后用平实语言回答,而不是把原始结果直接倒给你。
howto.when: 当你提到 “search memory”、“mem search”、“what do you remember about X” 等说法,或想了解某项目、决策、文件、任务的过往会话背景时触发。

say.text: 搜一下记忆,我们上次对 auth 模块做了什么
say.note: Claude 检索历史观察后作答

say.text: 你还记得这个项目架构上有哪些决定吗
say.note: 带上时间戳整理过往决策

say.text: 在记忆里找和登录报错相关的观察记录

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches your Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai — timestamped observations from past sessions across your agents. It runs broad keyword searches, narrows with specific terms, then answers in plain language instead of dumping raw output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like "search memory", "mem search" or "what do you remember about X", or ask for prior-session context about a project, decision, file or task.

say_en.text: Search memory: what did we do with the auth module last time?
say_en.note: Claude retrieves past observations and answers

say_en.text: What do you remember about this project's architecture decisions?
Find observations in memory about the login error
